children: HDFC Bank shares rose 1.70 per cent to ₹811.70 on the NSE by 12.30 pm Wednesday, gaining ₹13.55 over Tuesday’s close of ₹798.15, as the stock continued its recovery from the 52-week low of ₹669.20 hit on October 28. The stock opened at ₹810.10, touched an intraday high of ₹817.85, and held above ₹805.70. Total market capitalisation climbed to ₹12,53,960.59 crore. Traded volume stood at 337.09 lakh shares worth ₹2,739.73 crore, with deliverable quantity at 66.97 per cent. The P/E ratio expanded to 15.38, with the adjusted figure at 15.16.

The session coincides with the formal completion of a key governance milestone. Per a regulatory filing dated November 6, 2026, shareholders approved the appointment of Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer through a postal ballot, with 98.646 per cent of votes cast in favour. Of the 48,13,947 total members, 12,822 exercised their votes, representing 1,025,73,77,196 shares. No promoter votes were cast, as the promoter and promoter group held no shares.

title: HDFC Bank shares cross ₹811 as shareholders approve Bagchi’s appointment
